## 1. Professional & Research Overview
Abhay Vishwakarma is an undergraduate engineering student and systems architect at TCET Mumbai. His work spans autonomous aerial robotics, computer vision, private offline neural architectures, deterministic fault-tolerant systems, and full-stack software development.

---

## 2. Core Engineering Flagships

### Project 01: Aerial Intelligence Munitions (A.I.M.) / Cooperative UAV Perception & Geospatial Localization
- **Status:** Prototype / Active Research
- **Category:** Autonomous UAV Systems & Aerial Robotics
- **Architecture:** Hierarchical two-tier autonomous aerial perception system decoupling high-altitude standoff observation from tactical waypoint guidance.
- **Components:**
  1. High-altitude mother UAV video stream processed via real-time YOLOv8 object detection on edge hardware.
  2. Mathematical ray projection geodesy engine calculating line-of-sight intersection against the WGS-84 Earth ellipsoid based on 3-axis gimbal attitude, UAV altitude, and GPS coordinates.
  3. Low-latency peer-to-peer radio relay (ESP-NOW) dispatching target coordinates directly to child UAVs or tactical assets.
- **Verification Evidence:** Hardware-in-the-loop autonomous MAVLink 2.0 waypoint handover validated with sub-second coordinate resolution in flight tests.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/AbhayLabs-07/Aerial-Intelligence-Munitions-A.I.M-

### Project 02: MEDHA AI
- **Status:** Stable
- **Category:** Offline Neural Intelligence & Computer-Use Automation
- **Architecture:** Zero-telemetry, fully air-gapped local intelligent desktop assistant running indefinitely without external cloud APIs.
- **Components:**
  1. Custom feed-forward neural classification engine built from scratch in pure Python without heavy ML frameworks.
  2. MFCC-based acoustic wake-word detection and voice biometric verification.
  3. Operating system and web browser workflow automation via Playwright Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) and native Windows UIAutomation (UIA).
- **Verification & Performance:** 71 passing automated test cases across engine and desktop integration suites; sub-50ms local intent classification latency.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/AbhayLabs-07/MEDHA-AI

### Project 03: RecoverOps AI
- **Status:** Stable
- **Category:** Deterministic Systems Engineering & Self-Healing Workflows
- **Architecture:** Deterministic workflow execution engine replacing naive infinite retry loops with bounded recovery budgets and closed failure classifications.
- **Components:**
  1. Zero-dependency Python execution core.
  2. Path-jailed filesystem sandboxing preventing unintended state corruption.
  3. Declarative pre/post-execution assertions and atomic transactional audit logging backed by SQLite.
- **Verification Evidence:** 76 automated unit and fault-injection test cases passing across simulated network dropouts, corrupted payloads, and missing binary dependencies.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/AbhayLabs-07/recoverops-ai.git

### Project 04: Sentinel GCS
- **Status:** In Development
- **Category:** Tactical UAV Ground Control Station
- **Architecture:** Cross-platform ground control system for real-time mission planning, telemetry ingestion, and autonomous multi-vehicle monitoring.
- **Components:**
  1. Tactical React 18 HUD with 3D MapLibre GL terrain visualization.
  2. High-performance compiled Rust MAVLink 2.0 telemetry core for high-baud parsing.
  3. Cross-platform Tauri v2 Android and desktop container.
  4. Hardware USB OTG radio bridge operating up to 921,600 baud.
- **Verification Evidence:** 194-test regression suite passing across 15 test suites with strict flight-critical safety interlocks.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/AbhayLabs-07/sentinel.git

### Project 05: AI & Data Science Department Website (TCET Mumbai)
- **Role:** Web Developer
- **Architecture:** Single-page institutional web application representing the AI & Data Science Department at TCET Mumbai.
- **Scope:** Complete information architecture covering undergraduate programmes, department faculty, research focus, and department initiatives.

### Project 06: ERC TCET Community Platform
- **Role:** Web & Embedded Developer
- **Architecture:** Single-page application for the Electronics & Robotics Club at TCET Mumbai.
- **Scope:** Interactive project showcase with category filters across Robotics, UAV Systems, Embedded Systems, and Edge AI, supporting recruitment drives and technical symposiums.

## 3. Engineering Lab & Hardware Capabilities
- **Avionics & Telemetry:** Custom ArduPilot parameter tuning, PID calibration, hardware telemetry radio links (433MHz, 915MHz, 2.4GHz), antenna placement and RF link budgeting.
- **Computer Vision & Embedded Edge:** OpenCV CUDA pipelines, YOLOv8 model quantization, Jetson / Raspberry Pi / x86 compute payloads.
- **Microcontrollers & Circuits:** ESP32, STM32 (ARM Cortex-M), Arduino, sensor fusion (IMU, Barometer, Magnetometer, GPS/RTK), power distribution boards, and ESC signaling.
